data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘juzl’, meaning ‘gentle’, ‘soft’, or ‘flowing’. This name symbolizes the peaceful and calming nature of water, and is often given to girls in Islamic cultures. The name Juzla carries the meaning “Gentle Flow” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Juzla usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle flow and live with faith, good character and purpose.
